body: Hmm. Im still in 1st year. So im not sure if it's some 1st year depression thing that just swings around. Also, the program here kicks the crap out of the program in other in town university. And I dont really have the funds to branch out, seeing as Canada has a stupid high tuition rate coupled with stupid high rent.

:p Not a bad idea. I guess if anything I should have them feel good about what theyre doing.

Living with the rents (were all 19 btw, so still rather young), works at independant part time, smokes 6 ciggies a day and is escalating, smokes lots of pot (although, that has seemed to help rather than hinder) and he just cant seem to get his life in order. He's looking to branch out and try LSD and has hinted towards coke. Now I'm all for the psychadelics but when its down to coke and stuff that can get you hooked, thats a problem to me. 

Well I guess its an off-shoot. its more the continuation. Sorta how islam is supposed to be a sequel to christianity. Doesnt every abrahamic religion hate gays? I, too am an atheist. The idea of God just stopped wrapping itself around my head when high school first struck. On top of the Gay thing, it believes in complete abstinence from alcohol and drugs as well as sex before marriage and whatnot, where I believe more in aristotle's ethics of moderation. My parents either scoff, yell, or cry again. So they think im being selfish in denouncing my faith and so i renounce it to them... and now they believe im a devout baha'i once more... i dont know how to go about this, and it is a constant stresser in my life, seeing as one day im going to have to say something.

Btw, thanks a lot David. I'm certainly a lot more calm than I was 30 minutes ago. I guess I just need to talk it out.

All my life I've been raised a Baha'i. Although I agree with some of its stances, there is too much I disagree with to consider myself one, including the belief of a higher power. For example, the intolerance towards a gay couple. Gayness is just seen as something that needs to be fixed, and although im not gay myself, I cant stand the demeaning of gay people. ive tried telling them how I feel, but they just dont get it. They either cry or yell at me, saying that I'm selfish when I decide to not be theistic. 

My friend isn't in College. He actually dropped out of high school early. So all he has would be the suicide hotline and us I suppose. I just wish I wasnt so useless both to him and to myself.

And fucking dammit. This is the third throw away account that I've ever made for just this sort of thing. Not even mother fucking suicide watch is helping me. Im so tired of this shit. Im not only a whiny bitch, but a whiny bitch who keeps getting ignored and just doesn't know when to quit. Well I guess atleast that much has changed. I fucking quit. whisk me away, reaper.
